milestones.title: Code Quality & Refactoring
milestones.description: Systematic improvements to code structure, performance, and maintainability

ideas.title: Unified environment configuration
ideas.description: Create a single environment for the whole package (either .pipdata or .pipdataenv) instead of scattered configs

ideas.title: Standardize logging approach
ideas.description: Standardize log = TRUE argument vs. if statement pattern across functions and enforce consistent logging style. The DLW surface portion (eliminating log/save_log from pipdata_dlw_process, pipdata_get_gmd, pipdata_validate_gmd) is implemented as part of unified-logging-report (shared plan file). The pipaux portion — including the pipaux update log (accessible via pipfun::log_load(id = "pipaux_update_log", alias = "aux_meta")) in the unified logging surface so pipaux update events are captured alongside pipeline logs — remains a follow-on after B2, since pipaux uses a separate log name and incompatible logmeta schema.

ideas.title: Harmonize logging and reporting across pipdata
ideas.description: Unify the logging infrastructure so all pipdata functions (DLW acquisition, validation, and survey cleaning) write to the same piplog format and produce a single consolidated report via log_report(). Currently DLW functions (pipdata_dlw_process, pipdata_get_gmd, pipdata_validate_gmd) use a separate logging setup from the pipeline functions (pd_process_data, valid_dlw_load, update_pip_inventory) that feed log_report(). Goal: one log, one report, one set of logmeta conventions for the entire package.

ideas.title: Replace explicit loops with apply functions
ideas.description: Audit codebase for explicit for/while loops and replace with purrr::map(), collapse operations, or data.table vectorized patterns

ideas.title: Audit nested tryCatch patterns
ideas.description: Completed 2026-04-28: 22 tryCatch instances catalogued, zero true nested patterns found. The only open issue (conditional tryCatch in dlw_scan_and_validate.R:54-77) is moot — that file is legacy code slated for archival under Pipeline Alignment Audit. See .cg-docs/plans/2026-04-27-nested-trycatch.md.

ideas.title: Review get_wrk_release() in DLW functions
ideas.description: Completed 2026-04-23: Removed redundant get_wrk_release() guards from 4 delegate functions (pipdata_get_gmd, pipdata_validate_gmd, dlw_gmd_new, dlw_gmd_list). Guards kept at entry points and standalone utilities. See .cg-docs/plans/2026-04-23-remove-redundant-get-wrk-release.md.

ideas.title: Migrate from dplyr to collapse/data.table (Phase 1)
ideas.description: Replace dplyr/tidyr/tibble calls in pd_dlw_clean.R, pipdata_validate_gmd.R, and pipdata_validation_report.R with collapse/data.table equivalents. Phase 1 of 2.

ideas.title: Migrate dlw_scan_and_validate.R from dplyr to data.table (Phase 2)
ideas.description: Retired 2026-04-28: dlw_scan_and_validate.R identified as legacy pre-stamp code not called by either pipeline wrapper. File will be archived under the Pipeline Alignment Audit milestone instead of migrated.

ideas.title: Audit purrr usage and consider migration to lapply
ideas.description: Systematic audit of all purrr::map, purrr::map2, purrr::safely, purrr::possibly calls across pipdata to determine if replacement with base R lapply/sapply/tryCatch is justified. Phase 1 (2026-05-22 Phase 2 inventory work): Replaced purrr::map in pd_process_data.R and purrr::map2 in save_pip.R with lapply — aligns with project's minimalist data.table/collapse style and removes unnecessary tidyverse dependency for simple iteration patterns. Follow-up: audit remaining purrr calls in inv_dlw_load.R, pd_cpfw_merge.R, pd_deflation.R, pd_dlw_clean.R, pd_wbpip_clean.R, valid_aux_load.R (currently ~8 calls) and evaluate replacing them with lapply/sapply where the use case is basic iteration without type-specific purrr features.

ideas.title: Auto-sync YAML recode dictionary with stamp versioning
ideas.description: Replace hardcoded recode_edu(), recode_gndr(), recode_age() functions with a declarative YAML specification. Package YAML (inst/extdata/recode_spec.yml) is the source of truth — edit it directly, commit changes. Pipeline auto-syncs to stamp: sync_recode_spec() compares package YAML to latest stamp version, saves new version if changed. Implement: sync_recode_spec() auto-sync, apply_recode_spec() dispatcher with version_id attribute, typed handlers (recode_range, recode_binary, recode_haven), utility functions (export_recode_spec_yaml, import_recode_spec_yaml, list_recode_spec_versions, diff_recode_spec), and inventory tracking via version_id_recode_spec column. Benefits: zero manual sync, single source of truth, full GitHub tracking, fast qs2 loading at runtime.

ideas.title: Explore recode spec consolidation with dlw_pip_var_type.csv
ideas.description: Partial progress: inst/extdata/validation_spec.yml now exists and covers module-level validation rules (variable availability, types, categorical checks). The remaining gap is the name-mapping/type portion of dlw_pip_var_type.csv (DLW→PIP variable name mappings and pip_vars_class declarations), which is not yet absorbed into a YAML spec. Extended YAML could unify: (1) name mapping (dlw_var_names → pip_var_names), (2) type validation (expected class), (3) recode rules. Prerequisite: yaml-recode-dictionary (done). Deliverable: extend recode_spec.yml or validation_spec.yml to absorb dlw_pip_var_type.csv.

ideas.title: Replace 7 DLW validation functions with a single data-driven engine
ideas.description: Replace the 7 near-identical dlw_validation_*() functions (gpwg/group/bin/hist/all/aspire/l) plus dlw_validation_skip in R/pipdata_dlw_validation.R (~1,105 lines) with a single data-driven dlw_validation_engine() driven by inst/extdata/validation_spec.yml. Mirrors the yaml-recode-dictionary pattern. Output byte-identical to legacy functions (golden test), report format unchanged, dead code removed. Completed 2026-08-17; plan .cg-docs/plans/2026-08-17-dlw-validation-engine-refactor.md, work report .cg-docs/work-reports/2026-08-17-dlw-validation-engine-refactor.md.

ideas.title: Harden get_validation_report()/get_validation_list() table_name regex parsing
ideas.description: get_validation_report() derives module_type, vermast, veralt, country_code, and rf_year entirely from regex extraction on the table_name string (R/pipdata_validation_report.R lines 22-51). This is fragile: any change to the survey_id naming convention silently breaks the derived columns, and a malformed table_name produces wrong module_type='OTHER'/NA silently. The 2026-08-17 dlw-validation-engine-refactor plan confirmed `description` and `table_name` are downstream-consumed columns that must stay stable. This feature: (1) add guardrails/validation for the table_name format, (2) consider failing loudly instead of silently coercing to 'OTHER'/NA, (3) add tests that pin the expected naming convention. Out of scope of the engine refactor; tracked separately.

ideas.title: Replace regex-parsed table_name with typed/stamped validation report fields
ideas.description: Long-term: stop overloading table_name as a parsing key. Instead of regex-extracting module_type/vermast/veralt/country_code/rf_year from table_name at read time, store them as explicit typed columns when the validation record is appended (in dlw_validation_engine / pipdata_validate_gmd), so the report is self-describing and stamp-versionable. Removes the fragility tracked in validation-report-table-name-parsing and aligns the validation report with the stamp-based vintage tracking used elsewhere (remove-date-valid-filter). Prerequisite: dlw-validation-engine-refactor (done) so the engine is the single append point. Deliverable: typed columns written at validation time; get_validation_report()/get_validation_list()/get_validation_ctry() read typed fields instead of regex.

ideas.title: Rewrite DLW wrapper to mirror pipeline architecture
ideas.description: Long-term goal: rewrite pipdata_dlw_process() and delegates to structurally mirror pd_process_data() — survey-level map loop with tryCatch/piperr, unconditional logging, DLW summary logmeta entry. Enables future consolidation into a single end-to-end pipeline function. Prerequisite: unified-logging-report must be completed first (Approach 1).

ideas.title: Consolidate log checkpoint storage into a single folder/alias
ideas.description: Review the possibility of using a single stamp alias and folder for all log checkpoints (DLW and pipeline), instead of writing DLW checkpoints to dlw_meta and pipeline checkpoints to piplog. Simplifies log discovery and retrieval.

ideas.title: Persist pipeline log via stamp after each run
ideas.description: Pipdata_script.R (~lines 60-66) currently persists the log_report() output manually and ad-hoc: it calls stamp::st_init() with the piplog alias pointed at pip_repository/pip_logs, then stamp::st_save(log, "cleaning_log", alias = "piplog", verbose = FALSE). This is only test-script code today — neither log_report() nor pd_process_data() perform this save automatically, so log archiving depends on someone manually copying the snippet. Goal: formalize/automate this pattern (reusing the piplog alias / cleaning_log pin name) so the pipeline log is systematically archived via stamp after every run instead of relying on manual steps. Related to but distinct from unified-log-folder (consolidating checkpoint storage location) and unified-logging-report (harmonizing DLW + pipeline logging into one report) — this idea is specifically about automating the st_save() persistence step itself.

ideas.title: Replace date_valid filter with stamp-based vintage tracking
ideas.description: Remove the date_valid/date_validated filtering from update_pip_inventory() and valid_dlw_load(). All validated surveys get cleaned. Release inventory vintages are handled by stamp versions. Add first_release_version_id and latest_release_version_id columns to master inventory to track release membership.

ideas.title: Fix save_pip_data() memory resilience: largest-first order and GC guard
ideas.description: save_pip_data() fails with 'cannot allocate buffer' when a large merged survey (e.g. ARG_2014_EPHC-S2_INC_ALL) arrives late in the iteration loop after heap fragmentation has accumulated. Fix: sort iteration order largest-first by object.size() so big artifacts are written when the heap is cleanest, and add a gc() call before pip_write() for objects above a configurable threshold (getOption("pipdata.gc_threshold_bytes", 100e6)). No new imports — base R only.

ideas.title: Fix pd_process_data() OOM crash on full 4000+ survey inventory runs
ideas.description: Completed 2026-07-22: R session aborted mid-run because lapply(inv_ls, process_data) never freed survey intermediates (df, ls_cpfw, ls_clean, metadata) between iterations. Implemented explicit rm() + gc() inside process_data() after saves. The remaining root cause turned out to be pipfun::log_info()/log_add() capturing the full cleaned survey dt by reference into the persistent session log (.piplogenv) via capture_log_args() on every call, which defeated gc(); fixed by not emitting a per-survey log_info() inside apply_recode_spec() (see NOTE comment in R/recode_spec.R). The periodic gc()-in-main-loop safety net and NEWS.md bullet were determined unnecessary and not implemented. See .cg-docs/plans/2026-06-24-pd-process-data-oom-crash.md.

ideas.title: Register missing logmeta discriminator types in .log_internal_types
ideas.description: Several logmeta discriminator types emitted by current code are not registered in .log_internal_types (R/aaa.R:80-89), causing them to leak into the log_report() type-summary table. Missing types: aux_no_changes_inf, aux_changes_no_surveys_inf, surveys_to_clean_inf, force_surveys_inf, force_surveys_unknown_inf, aux_na_hash_inf, deflate_provenance_missing, missing_metadata_err. Audit all emitted discriminator types across the codebase against .log_internal_types and register the missing ones. Discovered during unified-logging-report plan review (P3.2) — deferred from B2 scope but should be done alongside or shortly after.

milestones.title: Function Decomposition & Cleanup
milestones.description: Break down large functions and remove dead code

ideas.title: Create subfunctions for long functions
ideas.description: Identify functions with excessive lines or complexity and extract subfunctions to improve readability and testability

ideas.title: Audit survey_id_to_vars usage
ideas.description: Completed 2026-04-23: All 3 calls in pipdata operate on different data objects from different sources (directory scan, newly built inventory rows). No redundancy found. See .cg-docs/plans/2026-04-23-audit-survey-id-to-vars.md.

ideas.title: Clean utils.R
ideas.description: Completed 2026-04-27: Phase A removed 3 dead comment blocks. Phase B audited all exported utils — demoted uniq_vars, uniq_vars_to_list, add_attributes to internal; removed dead code order_ver_inv, find_dt_with_attribute; kept uniq_vars_to_attr, vars_to_attr, num_vars_to_attr, unq_obs_dt, pipdata_int as exported. See .cg-docs/plans/2026-04-27-utils-cleanup.md.

milestones.title: Testing & Documentation
milestones.description: Enhance test coverage and documentation for existing functionality

ideas.title: Integration tests for logging side effects (P2.4)
ideas.description: Write integration tests to verify that valid_dlw_load() and update_pip_inventory() emit correct logmeta entries (aux_changes_inf, null_svys_inf, inv_update_inf, skipped surveys). Ensures logging contract stability and prevents regressions.

ideas.title: Resolve code review findings (2026-04-16)
ideas.description: Completed 2026-04-28: Fixed all 5 findings from 2026-04-16 review. P2.1: Added 9 edge-case tests for build_skipped_surveys/build_null_surveys/build_country_table. P2.2: Verified test contracts already correct (parse_log_meta usage). P2.3: Verified misaligned-vectors test exists and passing. P3.1: Verified file.path() used for portability. P3.2: Enhanced NULL-handling comment in build_header(). See .cg-docs/reviews/2026-04-16-review.md.

ideas.title: Implement verbose option propagation (Phase 1 & 2)
ideas.description: Completed 2026-06-04: Implemented verbose option propagation across 9 exported functions (pd_deflation, pd_process_data, pipdata_copy_dlw_meta, pipdata_dlw_process, pipdata_get_gmd, pipdata_validate_gmd, save_pip, valid_aux_load, valid_dlw_load). Added comprehensive test coverage for verbose propagation chains. Tests verify: Mode A (direct dt) and Mode B (pip_id) verbose propagation in pd_deflation(); verbose propagation to pipaux::compare_aux_releases/vintages in valid_aux_load(); verbose chain from valid_dlw_load() to valid_aux_load(). See .cg-docs/reviews/2026-05-08-verbose-option-propagation-review.md.

milestones.title: Pipeline Alignment Audit
milestones.description: Align pipdata codebase with the canonical three-wrapper architecture (pipeline_overview.qmd). Identify, archive, or reposition code not part of either wrapper's call tree.

ideas.title: Archive legacy DLW files
ideas.description: Move dlw_scan_and_validate.R, dlw_dta_to_qs.R, dlw_get_dta.R, and update_dlw_inventory.R to old_files/. These are pre-stamp workflow files not called by either pipeline wrapper. Remove exports, delete .Rd files, update NAMESPACE.

ideas.title: Archive pd_add_pip_vars.R (dead code)
ideas.description: pd_add_pip_vars.R defines pd_add_pip_vars(), add_pip_vars(), adjust_population() — none called by process_data() or any active pipeline path. Move to old_files/, remove exports.

ideas.title: Position pd_deflation.R as future pipeline step
ideas.description: pd_deflation.R contains deflation/PPP machinery not yet integrated into process_data(). Document its intended role in the pipeline, add @note or @details explaining it is a future step, ensure it stays buildable.

ideas.title: Relocate mock_funs.R to tests/ and audit
ideas.description: Move mock_funs.R to tests/testthat/helper-mock_funs.R. Audit which mocks are still needed (remove stale ones). Add cross-references in exported function roxygen to indicate which mock can be used for testing.

ideas.title: Audit pipdata_copy_dlw_meta.R standalone utility
ideas.description: Audit completed: retire copy_dlw_metadata() because it has no known callers and its cross-release logging, alias-state, and partial-write contracts are stale or unsafe. No replacement copier is introduced.

ideas.title: Document pipeline orchestration via vignettes (superseded orchestration-script idea)
ideas.description: Superseded 2026-08-03: originally proposed as a new orchestration script to replace Pipdata_script.R. Decided instead to document the orchestration architecture and end-to-end wrapper sequence (pipdata_dlw_process, pd_process_data, deflation, log_report) via two narrative vignettes rather than writing a new script. See .cg-docs/brainstorms/2026-08-03-pipeline-wrapper-vignettes.md. Fill vignettes/articles/PIP-data-pipeline.Rmd with the orchestration/architecture overview and rewrite vignettes/articles/Processing-Data.Rmd around pd_process_data + deflation + log_report. Completed 2026-08-04: all three vignettes (PIP-data-pipeline.Rmd, Processing-Data.Rmd, and the mid-execution addition Validating-Data.Rmd) finished, _pkgdown.yml updated, verification surface V1-V8 passed. See .cg-docs/work-reports/2026-08-03-pipeline-wrapper-vignettes.md.

ideas.title: Audit and fix \dontrun{} examples
ideas.description: Review all @examples blocks currently wrapped in \dontrun{} across the package. For each: determine whether the example can be made runnable (e.g., by using local test data or mocks), update it, or add a comment explaining why \dontrun{} is required (e.g., requires network access or a working release). Ensures examples are as useful as possible for documentation readers.

ideas.title: Fix subnational deflation: resolve area attribute to column values
ideas.description: Fix broken subnational deflation: when ppp_data_level or cpi_data_level are set to 'area' (per-row lookup), the deflation functions must resolve them to dt$area column values. Currently treated as literal level names, causing NA for all subnational surveys (CHN grouped data, etc.). Fast fix: modify add_rep_lvl(), add_ppp(), add_cpi() to handle 'area' sentinel. Prerequisite for integrate-deflation (affects S3 method refactoring in Step 3).

ideas.title: Integrate pd_deflation.R into the active pipeline
ideas.description: Update pd_deflation() so it can be called with a single cleaned survey data.table (or pip_id/version) and internally loads the corresponding metadata (CPI, PPP, pop) to return the deflated survey. No external aux args required. Batch iteration over many surveys belongs to pd_deflate_pipeline(). Extract safe_deflation() helper to deduplicate S3 methods. Prerequisite: subnational-deflation-fast-fix must be completed first (Step 0) so that refactoring in Step 3 and integration tests in Step 4 work for all survey types.

ideas.title: Store version_id in master inventory (not just content_hash)
ideas.description: format_vrs() currently saves only ventry$metadata (the stamp metadata dict) into the master inventory, which contains content_hash but drops version_id from the top level of pip_write()'s return value. This means .load_deflation_aux() must resolve version_id via an expensive hash lookup, which fails when the exact artifact has been replaced by a newer pd_process_data() run. Fix: capture ventry$version_id in format_vrs() and store it as version_id_data / version_id_metadata in the master inventory. Then pd_deflation() can load directly via pip_read(version = row$version_id_metadata) without any hash resolution.

ideas.title: Refactor inventory: catalog-based assembler
ideas.description: Replace update_pip_inventory() + format_vrs() with build_pip_inventory() that reads stamp catalogs via st_catalog_query(). Move enrichment (reporting_level, etc.) to pipload as pip_inv_enrich(). Simplify process_data() return. Cross-package: stamp (new export), pipdata (assembler), pipload (enrichment).

ideas.title: Evaluate run manifest vs process_summary_inf logging
ideas.description: Assess whether a persisted pip_run_manifest artifact (survey_id, status, timestamp per run) adds value beyond the existing process_summary_inf logmeta entry. If so, implement as a stamp artifact saved at end of pd_process_data(). Prerequisite: inventory-architecture-refactor.

ideas.title: Use content_hash_dlw to detect DLW source changes in inv_to_process
ideas.description: Enhance inv_to_process filtering to compare the previous master inventory's content_hash_dlw against the current DLW inventory's content_hash for each survey. If they differ, the DLW source data changed since last clean and the survey should be re-processed even if it was previously cleaned successfully. This avoids unnecessary re-cleaning of unchanged surveys while catching updated ones.

ideas.title: Create pd_deflate_pipeline() batch orchestrator
ideas.description: Build a pipeline wrapper that iterates over an entire inventory of cleaned surveys, applies pd_deflation() to each, saves deflated outputs to a stamp alias (e.g. pip_deflated), and logs a summary entry. Prerequisite: integrate-deflation must be completed first.

ideas.title: Make *_data_level attribute semantics explicit
ideas.description: Currently ppp_data_level/cpi_data_level attributes use 'area' as an implicit pointer to a column name, while 'national' is a literal level value. This dual semantics is confusing. Refactor to make the convention explicit — either use a structured encoding (e.g., list(column='area', values=c('rural','urban'))), or always store resolved level values directly. Requires changes across add_dom_vars(), pd_aux_attr(), add_ppp(), add_cpi(), add_rep_lvl(), and corresponding tests.

ideas.title: Gate aux-change detection on per-survey aux content-hash comparison
ideas.description: valid_dlw_load() always runs valid_aux_load()/compare_aux_*, which compare current aux data against the previous aux release/vintage — not against what the pipeline used last run — so every run re-cleans affected surveys unnecessarily. Fix: capture per-survey aux content hashes during processing (pd_aux_attr), surface them as new master-inventory columns (build_pip_inventory), and gate aux-change detection in valid_dlw_load() via a two-stage filter: (1) per-survey stored-vs-current aux hash comparison builds a candidate set; (2) valid_aux_load()/compare_aux_* runs only for changed measures, intersected with the candidate set.

milestones.title: Orchestration & Cache-Invalidation
milestones.description: Architecture for intelligent pipeline orchestration: dependency tracking, smart caching/invalidation, and targeted re-processing.

ideas.title: Implement pipdata staged dependency manifest
ideas.description: Build a pipdata-owned atomic dependency manifest with explicit clean, metadata, and deflate stages; record per-artifact provenance and stage code fingerprints; expose a read-only dependency planner/pd_change_report; target invalidation after a one-time full baseline rebuild; retain stamp as the authoritative artifact-version store; exclude an external orchestrator and estimation stage.

ideas.title: Add targeted force_surveys parameter to pd_process_data()
ideas.description: Add a `force_surveys` parameter (character vector of survey_ids) to pd_process_data(). When supplied, only those surveys are re-processed regardless of inventory state, WITHOUT switching stamp to timestamp versioning (which is what force=TRUE does globally). This enables surgical re-runs for specific countries/years/measures without destroying version history for other surveys. Implementation: (1) add `force_surveys = NULL` parameter, (2) in valid_dlw_load(), when force_surveys is non-NULL, intersect it with inv_to_clean rather than bypassing all invalidation, (3) keep force=TRUE behavior unchanged for full re-runs.

ideas.title: Consolidate 7 DLW validation functions into data-driven validator
ideas.description: Replace the 7 near-identical validation functions in pipdata_dlw_validation.R (~1,105 lines, ~900 duplicated) with a single dlw_validation_engine(dlw_data, svy_id, module_spec) function. Each module type (GPWG, GROUP, BIN, HIST, ALL, ASPIRE, L) is defined by a declarative spec (YAML or named list) specifying: variable regexes (weight vars, welfare vars, numeric vars, character vars), optional checks (urban, gender, hhid/pid), and range constraints. The dispatch table in pipdata_validate_gmd.R maps module → spec instead of module → function. Benefits: (1) bug fixes applied once, (2) new module types are one-line config changes, (3) ~900 lines eliminated. Prerequisite: archive-legacy-dlw (done).

ideas.title: Build dependency DAG for step-level cache invalidation
ideas.description: Define a formal dependency graph between pipeline steps (inv_dlw_load → pd_cpfw_merge → pd_dlw_clean → pd_aux_attr → save_pip_data → pd_deflation) with per-step input hashes tracked in the master inventory. When an upstream input changes (e.g., CPI data), only steps that depend on CPI (pd_aux_attr, pd_deflation) are invalidated — not the entire survey cleaning pipeline. Implementation: (1) define the DAG as a named list in aaa.R (step → depends_on), (2) compute per-step input hashes (e.g., pd_dlw_clean hashes the recode spec, pd_aux_attr hashes CPI/PPP/pop content), (3) store step-level hashes in a new inventory column or a separate step_hash artifact, (4) in pd_process_data(), skip steps whose inputs haven't changed. This is the core architecture for the user's vision: 'if Colombia 2018 CPI updates, recompute only downstream.' Prerequisites: code-hash-invalidation, targeted-force-surveys.

ideas.title: Formalize pipeline stage interface with typed result objects
ideas.description: Define a pipdata_stage_result S3 class (or structured list) with required fields: status (success/partial/failed), data (stage output), log_entries (structured logmeta list), errors (list of caught conditions). Each pipeline stage (acquisition, validation, cleaning, deflation) returns this contract. The orchestrator (pipdata_dlw_process / future top-level run_pipeline()) can inspect stage results, chain errors, and resume from a failed stage. Also define a shared pipeline_context object holding release, identity, folder paths, and aux data — passed to each stage instead of each calling pipfun::setup_working_release() independently. This turns the package from a collection of independent scripts into a true orchestration engine. Prerequisites: safe_pipeline_step wrapper (for consistent error handling). Blocks: parallel survey processing, DAG-based invalidation.
